items.quote: went on to Laish, against a people at peace and secure. They attacked them with the sword
items.contrast: The people at Laish are the recipients of the attack, whereas Micah is only identified as the person whose objects and priest were taken.
items.reason: Micah is a plausible nearby referent, but the movement to Laish and the phrase “against a people” establish that “them” refers to the people there. The question clearly asks for the target of the Danites’ attack and the key fully answers it.
